content:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`**

That module holds the full memo CRUD surface — list (`listMemos`, web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:116,126), get (`getMemo`, :146), create (`createMemo`, :183), update (`updateMemo`, :202), and delete (`deleteMemo`, :258), plus comment queries (:276, :296).

The generated service client it uses is `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:5) and created in web/src/connect.ts:197 via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` — a Connect-RPC client generated from the `MemoService` proto definition (typed in web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts).
